notes: Loanword from English 'jacket'. Counted with 件 (jiàn). Note that 夹 is pronounced in the first tone (jiā) here, though some speakers use the second tone (jiá).
Refers specifically to a waist-length casual jacket, whereas 外套 (wàitào) is a general term for any outer coat or jacket.
